item.text: {"summary":"Draft is mostly publication-ready, but it should resolve the apparent omission of the latest available CMS March 2026 Delaware row before publication.","requiredFixes":[{"rubricItem":"update","severity":"blocking","summary":"The draft notes CMS Preliminary March 2026 data were available as of June 26, 2026, but the quantitative prior uses February 2026 as the latest inspected Delaware first-print value.","actionRequested":"Check the official CMS dataset for Delaware March 2026 original/preliminary first-print ex parte share, incorporate it if available, or explicitly state that the Delaware March value was unavailable/unusable and why."}],"optionalSuggestions":["Explain why the historical sample skips intervening months if those months are absent, unavailable, or intentionally excluded.","Consider stating that the five-point history is a limited local sample, so the interval is widened for sample-size uncertainty as well as realized volatility."]}
